model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of several language models over a series of steps during hard training set evaluation. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300, with tick labels spaced every 20 units. The y-axis is labeled “Hard Training Set” and represents a logarithmic scale, starting at approximately 0.0 and increasing to a maximum value of approximately 1.0. A solid blue line represents the Llama-On-Policy-Easy model, which begins at a value near 0.0 and gradually increases to a value of approximately 0.95 by step 300. A solid red line represents the Llama-LUFFY-Easy model, which begins at a value near 0.0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.85 by step 300, and a dashed brown line represents the Llama-On-Policy-Hard model, which begins at a value near 0.0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.90 by step 300. A solid pink line represents the Llama-LUFFY-Hard model, which begins at approximately 0.0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.75 by step 300.
